segments.oily: Several reviewers with oily or oily/combination and acne-prone skin describe the cleanser as effective without over-stripping, though one dissenting reviewer suggests the product may actually suit very oily skin best, as it left drier/combination skin feeling tight.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-leaning combination skin are split: some report the cleanser hydrates and does not dry out their skin, while others say it left their skin stripped, tight, and flaky.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers give mixed reports, with some praising it for oily t-zones and acne-prone combination skin and others (dry-leaning combination) reporting stripping and tightness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most divided group: many describe it as calming, non-irritating and safe, but others report burning, redness, swelling, or a chemical-burn-like reaction, especially around the eyes.
segments.normal: The one reviewer identifying as normal, non-sensitive skin reports no bad reaction and a clean feeling, with only a minor complaint about makeup removal.

concerns.aging: No reviewer discusses anti-aging effects specifically for this cleanser.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers report dryness, tightness, or flaking after use, particularly with regular/nightly use, while a comparable number of other reviewers (including some with dry skin) say it left skin hydrated and not dried out.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports no redness and a calm, balanced result; another separate reviewer reports ongoing redness and raw skin around the eyes after a reaction.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers describe it as barrier-friendly and gentle with no flare-ups; at least two reviewers explicitly say their skin barrier felt disrupted or 'jacked up' after use.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with acne-prone skin mostly report no new breakouts and some improvement, but one reviewer reports dry, flaky patches emerging where they hadn't had them before.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers say it helps prevent breakouts and cleans effectively without irritating existing blemishes; no reviewer reports worsened acne, though one reports skin barrier issues after use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers consistently report it cuts oil and shine without leaving skin greasy; no dissent found on this point.

extraits.texte: It kills me to say this because I have loved almost every product from BYOMA. However, this one just isn't it for me. What ruins this product for me is the way it's described: hydrating, gentle, perfect for all skin types. In reality, it is nothing of the sort. For reference I have dry-leaning combination skin, and everytime I tried to use this my skin felt dry, stripped and tight afterwards. Granted it made my skin feel very clean, but in the way that just feels really tight and uncomfortable. I like cleansers that make my skin feel squeaky clean, but this is just too much, especially since it is described as "hydrating." I think this would be better suited for very oily skin, and I wish the brand would say that instead of marketing it as being "for all skin types." I still love BYOMA, but this is currently my least favorite product from the brand.

extraits.titre: Not a win for this sensitive skin girlie
extraits.texte: I bought this Jelly Cleanser (brightening toner + Barrier repair) based on the BYOMA skin care test on their website.). Worst line of products ive ever used. woke up face swollen, rash and chemical burn all over my face.

I really love almost all Byoma products so it pains me to say this but I really didn't like this cleanser. It is advertised as a good daily cleanser option, that is hydrating and cleanses without leaving the skin stripped. I have dry-leaning combination skin, so I was really excited for this product. Unfortunately, I found that everytime I used this (I used it for about 3 weeks, every night) my skin felt extremely stripped and dry. I thought it might be the amount of product I was using so I tried using a bit less, but my skin still felt stripped, even in the areas of my face that tend to be a bit more oily. To be fair, my skin DEFINITELY felt very clean, albeit very stripped. Since I already bought the product, I just use it on mornings where I might've forgotten to cleanse the night before, to really get that "clean skin" feeling (and then just really lather up with moisturizer). I feel like this could be a good option for someone with very oily skin, but that is not at all how this is advertised. If you are someone with combo/normal/dry skin, I would personally not recommend this product.

extraits.titre: Great for my acne prone combination skin!
extraits.texte: My skin is so finicky with face cleansers. Most of them leave my t-zone crazy oily and my cheek/mouth area flaky and tight. I tried this cleanser after going through every cerave one, youth to the people, clinique, you name it and I love it so much. It has a light lather and takes makeup and oil right off without stripping. It's perfect in that it also doesn't make my skin too dry when I use harsher acne products. I can't recommend this cleanser enough and I love the low price!

so tough to find anything good for my sensitive, dry, acne prone skin, that also doesnt have niacinamide or squalane (allergic). this is so gentle & perfect & ive seen a huge difference in a few weeks < 3

I have sensitive acne and eczema-prone skin. Since I bought this cleanser, I have been happy with how it works with my skincare routine in the morning. It leaves my skin feeling clean with no eczema flare-ups and no breakouts either. I would definitely recommend this product for sensitive-skinned girlies to start off your skincare journey.
This cleanser is a dream—no redness, no itchiness, just calm, clean skin that feels balanced and happy after a long day.
